annotations.title: Start listing a property to sell or let (link)

description: For an owner who wants to advertise their own property for sale or to let on OpenMoov without an estate agent: returns the link that starts the listing wizard, and what they will need. Creates nothing — no account, no draft, nothing is published; the owner signs in and builds the listing themselves. If they would rather use an estate agent, use request_valuation instead.

intent.description: "sell" to sell, "let" to rent it out
